study_title: Cross-Project Heterogeneity in Quality-Oriented Engineering Change
design: Secondary observational analysis of maintenance-intent composition across Apache projects
canonical_source: Trautsch et al. replication dataset on Zenodo
taxonomy_note: The source authors map perfective to internal-quality improvement intent and corrective to external-quality improvement intent. No source row has both flags true; this is treated as taxonomy structure rather than an empirical negative association.
source_sampling_note: The source article reports a random sample of approximately 2% of eligible commits per project, rounded up, for manual classification.
rights_note: The Zenodo record is open but does not display a specific dataset license value. The peer-reviewed article is CC BY 4.0. This repository therefore avoids republishing manual_labels.csv and stores derived aggregate tables only.
scientific_correction: Version 1.1 removes the phi/four-state interpretation, packages all 54 projects with Wilson intervals, and uses sample-size-sensitive project×category heterogeneity analysis.
